inventory.notes: Initial bounded Python feature row. This is not an inventory of all Python capabilities or a claim of native pcc1 qualification.

features.title: Unicode identifier classification and NFKC normalization
features.scope: Implementation includes owned Unicode 17 XID and NFKC data, UTF-8 source offsets, and preservation of raw soft-keyword spelling. Missing means qualification remains incomplete: host unit checks exist; native program/reference, pcc1, and affected Lib/test results are still pending. No complete Python language claim is made.
